name: @gcu/archive
description: Archive format handling for the GCU stack — ZIP, tar, tar.gz, tar.xz, tar.bz2, gz, xz, bz2 read and write, tar.zst and zst read. Pure JavaScript (xz and bzip2 via @gcu/lzma and @gcu/bz2, inlined), no Wasm. Source-agnostic API (VFS, in-memory, streams) used by Auditable Works for native archive workflows and by @gcu/coreutils to back tar / gzip / unzip builtins.
author: Arthur Endlein Correia
